name: state_scatter_with_mask
description: Masked cache state scatter for speculative decoding. dst is [layers, cache, *state_shape], src is [layers, requests, draft, *state_shape], and dst_indices_raw/step_indices_raw are int32 [requests]. For every request i with step_indices_raw[i] >= 0, copy the full state slice src[:, i, step_indices_raw[i], ...] into dst[:, dst_indices_raw[i], ...]; requests with a negative step are skipped. The native kernel writes dst in place and returns it (or a contiguous copy if the input is non-contiguous); src and the index tensors are read only. Suites exercise float32 state tensors plus one bfloat16 case.
